utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, may I just ask the witness one question, please?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, if it is useful and relevant, and if it follows along from the guess that Mr. Praljak asked.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Certainly. That is why I wish to ask it.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: The witness is being heard under Rule 94 bis or, rather, ter, I apologise. 94 ter, and we have his statement here. Good afternoon, sir or, rather, good evening. You confirmed today that on the 20th of June -- no. On the 27th of June, 2001, you gave a statement to the OTP; is that right?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: On page 3 of that statement we have the following sentence where you say, and you confirmed that today: "I know that there were sniper positions on the elevation point called Stotina and on the hill called Hum. Stotina is closer than hill -- than Hum hill, and from Stotina the snipers could easily see me, and I suppose," and I'd like to underline the word "suppose," "that this shot came from Stotina." Now, my question is the following: Did you make that statement?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Is it correct that everything you told us today about Stotina is just your assumption?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: How do you mean my assumption? What do you mean my assumption? Explain. I don't know what you mean by this term "assumption."

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: You don't know the word "assumption"?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: I apologise. I do know what the word means.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: I am conducting the cross-examination. You can either answer or not, but I am doing the questioning, and what I'm asking you is this: Do you consider, do you think that the shot hit you from Stotina?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: Yes, I do think that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: Do you believe that or are you 100 per cent certain of that?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: I can only guess.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: Thank you, sir. Good-bye.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Next counsel.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: Witness, Mr. Klaric, just very conveniently the picture up on the screen is what I want to ask you about. Do you see that? Can we be clear? When you went to fetch water from the river you went straight down those concrete steps that we see in front us. So you went to the left of that yellow object, straight down to the river, did you?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: To tell you the honest truth, I really don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: Well, you've given us a lot of -- of quite specific information, and you've given a lot of information about what went on, so you're actually saying -- if that is the position, you're actually saying that the one thing you do not remember is at what point down by the river bank you were going to fetch water? Is that your evidence?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: The part where I went to fetch the water is called Kusalova Sokak.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: But looking straight down from the left of that yellow object and down what appear to be steps, did you fetch your water from straight ahead or to the right as we're looking at it or to the left as we're looking at it. At what point on the river bank is what I'm asking?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: Can I ask you a question?

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: Answer mine, please, unless it's --

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: I can't see the steps here, the steps I went down to the left to get down to the water. I can't see those steps on this photograph.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: All right. Let's -- I'm going to have to ask for the 360 degree picture. Is there any technical difficulty with that now? I think not. I don't mind which way. I'd prefer to go the other way. Thank you very much. Now, can you just stop when you see the points where you got water from the bank?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: Stop.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: And so identify then, well, first of all by description then where -- we've got a sort of -- it's like a small pylon isn't it, right -- almost in the middle of the picture do you see. The upright structure. Where in relation to that did you fetch water from the bank?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: In the direction of this building and then left where the steps were. I went down to the left.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: You see, the reason I'm asking you this, Witness, is that we have -- you may not know all the details of this, but we have an expert report and it has diagrams. It has details of this incident. You are apparently one of the main sources if not the main source of information about this incident, and what we have -- I can tell you, you can take it from me, what we have on that diagram is we have shown a straight line from the river where you got your water to the steps, and you're saying that's not so, that you -- can I just get it clear, that you didn't go from the bottom of the steps by the house? You did not go straight ahead to the river to get water, is that what you're saying?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: Your Honour, I think, and that is my conviction, that I went left from the Sokak or path towards the Neretva. I can't say for sure because it's been a long time since then.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: Your Honour, it's got absolutely uncontroversial, two tiny uncontroversial marks one of which is the witness's name. May I ask for the diagram - it's page 29 of the expert's report - to be put to the witness. I've got it here. I really do think the markings are uncontroversial. If Mr. Scott is in doubt about it --

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Yes, I do. And before it's shown to the witness -- I ask that it not be shown to the witness until I make my comments and make my objection. I think it's unfair to ask -- put this to the witness in this way. If the witness -- if the expert is wrong, they can cross-examine the expert on this. But they shouldn't show the expert's report and talk him in -- essentially talk him into changing his position. Now, his testimony has been clear; it's been clear all along, quite frankly. If anyone in the court courtroom would like to go back to transcript page 81 and 83, he quite indicated that he came up further down in this picture on this path he had his back to Stotina. If anyone here thinks I'm making it up, please look at page 81. He had his back to Stotina when he walked back up from the river down here up this path toward the steps, where he turned up into the steps. Now that's his testimony. It's been his testimony all day, if you look at page 81.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: First of all I'm cross-examining --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Stewart, with respect to this matter we could spend 10 hours on it, because the expert report shows that he is going from the Neretva towards the steps, and on the photograph a moment ago we see that there was a detour. Anyway, Witness, to the best of your recollections, can you tell us whether you went to fetch water directly in front of the steps or did you make a detour anywhere?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I went to the left.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: Your Honour, may I --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] So you didn't go straight ahead.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, no.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: Your Honour, you've been on my feet for about six minutes. A couple of minutes of which have been taken up which objections. I'm actually only asking for two or three minutes, but I'm asking to do my cross-examination professionally, in the way I propose to do it, and there is nothing wrong with this these witnesses are brought as the foundation for the expert report it is for the Defence, the Defence are entitled to be clear, the relationship between this evidence and the expert's evidence. We're entitled to find out in advance from the factual witnesses whether what we see in the expert report is correct or not.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Stewart, I didn't say anything contrary to that. Quite the opposite. The witness is going along the lines of what you said. So proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: I'm much obliged, Your Honour I'm answering Mr. Scott's objection. I appreciate that Your Honour may I have that page shown to the witness then, please, on the ELMO as requested that's page 29 the usher has it.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: Now, just so that we're clear what it is, the river is of course at the bottom of this diagram. That's the shade I had area marked Neretva and then river in English. We see the steps at the top, and we see a dotted line. It's -- "route of victim" is the English. You're getting that in translation. A dotted line more or less a straight line it weaves a tiny bit more a less a straight line from the river to the steps and the point is that as that line goes up from the river toward the steps, those flower-beds, the slightly scrubby flower-beds we've seen on the picture are to the right. Now, what I want to be very clear about please because you were there I'm asking you what I want to be clear about is that line that is drawn by, or for the expert, there showing your route from the river to the steps, is that right or wrong as a graphic description of what happened?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: I can't remember.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: I'll move on then. Before you got to the river you said that snipers were constantly shooting during the day and night. "It was quiet for half an hour and this is why I went to get some water from the river." So what -- before that quiet spell, before that lull, how much shooting was going on?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: Judge, I was in the house, and I went to fetch water.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] He's not the Judge. I'm the Judge, so look at me.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I apologise. I left the house carrying a canister and a barrel on a wheelbarrow to fetch some water. I don't know how much shooting the sniper is doing. There was shooting during the day and during the night. Whether it was half an hour or hour, I don't know, but they were shooting. I can't say how long they were shooting for because they're looking for a target and then they shoot once they've found one.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: Mr. Klaric, I'm going to pursue your own evidence. You are the one who said in your statement and today that it was quiet for half an hour. Now, if you're saying it was quiet for half an hour, it that clearly implies that before that period of a half an hour it wasn't quiet. So what I'm asking you is how far was it not quiet before that half an hour lull? How much noise, how much shooting was going on before you noticed that it had gone quiet for half an hour?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: I left my home and went to the Neretva. I wasn't outside to know whether the sniper was shooting or not I went to fetch water and it's about 250 to 300 metres from my home to Neretva and I came back. I wasn't outside for any lengths of time for me to know how much shooting there was or whatever, but when I went to the Neretva it was calm until I was wounded.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: You don't know when you hear shooting you have no idea whether it's a sniper or not, have you? You keep saying sniper, but shooting is shooting. You have no idea whether it comes from a sniper, have you?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: I didn't hear the bullet hit me at all. I didn't hear the bullet that hit me at all. I just felt the fall.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: Are you all right now? You can hear me all right now again, can you?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: Yes, I can.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: How long -- you made six or seven trips to the river you said. How long in total were you at the river?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Stewart, we have to end there.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: Your Honour, this is a relevant question, and I've had a very short time, Your Honour, a very, very short time. After a long afternoon of examination-in-chief I've got about two more questions, Your Honour that I should, with respect, be allowed to finish them.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: Witness, how long in total were you --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Go ahead.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: -- at the river?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: About 20 minutes.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: And how many people were around roughly on the bank?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: I was alone and there were three children. Those three children had gone out before me, and the last canister that I was supposed to take is when the shot was heard. While I was carrying the water to my last carrying of the canister there was no shooting. It was in the last moments that the shot came.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. That was my last question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Counsel Tomic, any questions? MS. TOMASEGOVIC TOMIC: [Interpretation] No.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Ibrisimovic, how about you?

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] By some extraordinary chance, does Mr. Scott have additional questions.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, I'm sorry, if I could be very brief.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Get through them quickly.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: If I could be handed -- if I could be handed IC 00341. The problem is, Your Honour, unfortunately we don't really have one of these exhibits floating around the courtroom, it becomes difficult to make sure we've used the right exhibit. They're not marked. They don't have numbers on them. Can I see it first, please, just because I have to --

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Sir, please look at the ELMO and listen very, very carefully because our time is limited and I want to do this as briefly as possible. I showed you this photograph earlier when we made the markings on it that you can see now. At the time I asked you about, I also asked you where you came up from the river, and I don't know if you make your markings -- you made a marking down in the lower right corner. There's a line coming across the path. Do you see the line?

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Your Honour, can I approach the ELMO in the interests of time? May I go to the ELMO?

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Sir, I want to direct your attention to this point, the this point on the line. Is it your testimony that that is the point where you came onto the path having come up from the river that you came onto the path at that location?

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: My recollection is that Mr. Scott asked the witness where he came into the photograph earlier. I appreciate he may be asking a slightly different question but he needs to be clear if the question is different.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: I think the question is the same.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Sir, can you answer my question? Is the top of that line crossing the -- what loose like an open gravel area, is that where you came up from the river? Sir? Apparently we're not -- are we getting translation?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: Somewhere about there.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Can I ask you, this is a still photograph. This is another still photograph that we've just made from the 360 when Mr. Stewart was asking questions. Can we put that on the ELMO. Sir, if you look at this photograph which is basically the same photograph Mr. Stewart showed you, I ask you to look at that and point out as best you can the point at which you came onto that -- I'm going to say the flat gravelly area, I don't want to characterise it any more than that, can you tell approximately where on that photo you came onto that?

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Well, I mean, it's not in the trees, Your Honour. He said he came up to the path.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: So I'm asking where you came onto the path.

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: And is that approximately in front of -- to the right of this part of the building that juts -- can you see this building, part of the building here?

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: This is exactly what Mr. Praljak does, Your Honour, so I'm going to do exactly the same thing.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: You see this here? You see this area here?

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: I'm having him show it in the interests of time. If you want to take another half hour we'll do it that way. Let me go on to my next question. Sir, we can argue from the diagrams where it was now that we have that marking because you see where it is on the marking, where he comes onto the path. From the expert diagram?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, but perhaps we'll have a number.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Yes. It's the same -- I don't think --

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Go ahead.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We need a number.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, this will be IC 349.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: My final question, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: The photographs that we've seen of the area on the steps that you crawled up in between the two buildings, can you tell the Judges how that would have provided you any cover or protection if the shot had come from directly across the river?

utterances.speaker: MUNIB KLARIC
utterances.text: I was at the beginning of the steps when I was hit, and then I crawled up a step or two to reach the sheltered area in the street, and that's where the sniper identified me, the sniper or whatever it was. It could have been a tank.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. Sir, this completes your testimony, and on behalf of my colleagues I would like to thank you for having answered all the questions put to you by the various parties, even if at time -- at times it seemed as if the questions were very technical, but it was necessary to put you such questions. I wish you a safe trip home and all the best in your current profession. Tomorrow we will be sitting in the afternoon. We will resume our hearings at 2.15. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I thank you, too, and I wish you good health and a lot of happiness.
